newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT invests Dm6.7mln in German freight cen.
newsitem.headline: TNT invests Dm6.7mln in German freight cen.

text.p: TNT Express GmbH, the German express goods division of global integrator TNT Worldwide Express, is investing 6.7 million marks ($3.9 million) in new regional centres.
A 4.3 million mark freight centre covering 6,610 square metres, including 1,215 square metres of handling space, would open in August in Herbolzheim, near Freiburg, a statement said.
In September, a 2.4 million mark centre with 5,830 square metres, including a 636 square metre freight hall, would go into service at Barleben, near Magdeburg.
TNT Express, with 1,950 staff in 29 outlets, earned German sales revenue of 327 million marks and handled five million express items in the 1995-96 fiscal year.
Sister company, TNT Worldwide Express, with 1,300 employees at 24 stations, handled 4.9 million international shipments in Germany and recorded a turnover of 310 million marks.
TNT, part of PTT NEDERLAND, offers overnight transport of documents, parcels and heavier freight within Germany and to European and overseas destinations.
